name: print-social-navy-fintech-credit-app-post-mosaic-with-profile-mockup
title: Six navy and white credit-app posts with phones and office photos, plus a black Instagram profile mockup

techniques: Feature the phone UI in perspective.
Use business photography with a navy overlay.
Show the whole feed in a profile mockup.
bestFor: Fintech and credit app social sets
